players.product: retail colocation & interconnection (IBX data centers, Equinix Fabric) and xScale hyperscale data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Equinix's Q2 2026 release (quarter ended June 30, 2026): revenues of $2.625 billion, driven by strong underlying performance and one-time xScale fees; adjusted EBITDA of $1.396 billion at a record adjusted EBITDA margin of 53% as printed in the release. Worldwide colocation revenues were $1,772 million versus $1,585 million in the quarter ended June 30, 2025, interconnection revenues $453 million versus $407 million, and non-recurring revenues $248 million versus $113 million (in millions, as printed in the release table).
quarterly_data.figure: revenues $2.625 billion; adjusted EBITDA $1.396 billion (53% margin); colocation $1,772 million vs $1,585 million; interconnection $453 million vs $407 million

quarterly_data.signal: Equinix guided Q3 2026 revenues of $2.525 to $2.575 billion (an increase of 9 - 11% over the previous year as reported) and adjusted EBITDA of $1.275 to $1.315 billion (~51% margin), and full-year 2026 revenues of $10.205 to $10.285 billion. In the 2026 guidance table, non-recurring capital expenditures (excluding xScale and real estate acquisitions) were revised to $4,710 - 5,690 million from ~$3,800 million prior (guidance adjustment +$1,438 million). The long-term outlook table raises total capital expenditures (annual range) to $5,000 - 7,000 million in the updated 2027 - 2029 outlook from $3,000 - 4,000 million in the prior outlook as provided June 25, 2025 (excluding future M&A activity, real estate acquisitions and xScale joint-venture investments); the release also cites nine new projects added since April.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenues $2.525-$2.575 billion; FY2026 revenues $10.205-$10.285 billion; 2026 non-recurring capex $4,710 - 5,690 million (prior ~$3,800 million); total capex annual range $5,000 - 7,000 million (prior outlook $3,000 - 4,000 million)
